topics.label: Course introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the final lecture of the course and outlines the learning objectives regarding cancer therapies and their modes of action.

topics.label: Surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover conventional cancer treatment modalities that physically remove, irradiate, or systemically poison rapidly dividing cells.

topics.label: Exploiting specific vulnerabilities and genetic defects in cancer cells
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine therapies designed to target intrinsic cancer vulnerabilities, including hormone receptor dependencies, cell cycle checkpoint losses, and DNA repair defects.

topics.label: Targeted kinase inhibitors and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how oncogene-addicted kinases are targeted by small-molecule inhibitors and explain how tumors develop drug resistance and addiction.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe targeted therapies that use engineered antibodies to disrupt receptor signaling or deliver cytotoxic payloads directly to tumor cells.

topics.label: Cancer immune surveillance and immune checkpoint blockade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the evidence for immune surveillance against tumors and explain how checkpoint inhibitor therapies reactivate T cells against tumor neoantigens.

topics.label: Bispecific T-cell engagers and CAR T-cell therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine synthetic immunology approaches that physically recruit or genetically engineer T cells to attack cancer cells.

topics.label: Modern challenges, future directions, and ethical dilemmas in cancer therapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess broader clinical considerations in oncology, including tumor heterogeneity, genomic stratification, historical survival trends, and ethical dilemmas surrounding treatment choices.
